title: Dates drawn over date inputs, text fields and radios
blurb: Five date controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a campsite night on a date input and a dialog of radios, a best-before code on three text fields, a library renewal receipt on a details, a two-colour wall calendar and a day out on a list of radios.
question: The picker of a date input is drawn by the system, so how much of a date picker can be made from elements that stay in the canvas, and can the date input itself still be typed in while it is drawn?
result: The date input's field is drawn and takes typing, and its picker is replaced by a dialog of radios opened with the open attribute, which stays in the canvas. Three text fields, a details and two lists of radios made the rest. Inert copies of an element in a second style are how one look is faded or moved over another. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
